channel.title: DRP BuildLab blog
channel.description: How we build websites, webshops and automations.

item.title: What a CRM actually does for a small business (and when you don't need one)
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: What a CRM really does for a small business, five signs you have outgrown the spreadsheet, when you don't need one yet, and how to start in one week.

item.title: Small business, big target? Cybersecurity in plain language
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: Why small businesses are in the picture too, why most attacks start with a person, and what you can do about it. Plus what we check and set up on your website, explained in plain language.

item.title: Short video is not a hype. You just don't have to dance in it.
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: Why short video is here to stay for small businesses, what to film, what to skip and how to fit it into your week. A scenario in four sentences, a practical five-step guide and a note on rights and consent.

item.title: Your customer no longer googles. They ask.
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: What changes for your website when people increasingly ask an AI instead of searching, and what you can do about it tomorrow. A checklist, an example service page and a way to check whether it works.

item.title: Is your visitor talking to a human? Say so honestly.
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: Why a chatbot on your website should play with open cards, and how to do that without it getting awkward. What the rules say, how to test your bot and which questions to ask your supplier.

item.title: Why we don't start at nine o'clock
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: On working when you are sharp, and why at our place the clock mostly ticks for the client. How we agree on results instead of hours, what can go wrong, and how to start yourself.

item.title: Checking out without the hassle: what customers expect in 2026
item.dc:creator: Dries De Smedt
item.description: On payment methods, drop-off moments and why the checkout of your webshop matters as much as your shop window. What customers expect in 2026, and how to build a payment flow that does not get in the way.
